question.title: Thread-Safe Producer-Consumer Blocking Queue
question.prompt: Implement a thread-safe bounded buffer `BlockingQueue<T>` in Java using `wait()`, `notifyAll()`, and explicit synchronized blocks or methods. Ensure safety against spurious wakeups and handle buffer overflow/underflow correctly.
question.solutionNotes: Must use `while (queue.size() == capacity)` and `while (queue.isEmpty())` around `wait()` to guard against spurious wakeups (using if is a flaw). Must call `notifyAll()` instead of `notify()` to avoid deadlocks. Synchronize on shared intrinsic lock.

sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_a: Prof. Tariq Mahmud: Both synchronized method syntax and synchronized(this) block syntax accepted.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_b: Lec. Nusrat Jahan: Explicit ReentrantLock with Condition variables (notEmpty, notFull) also accepted for full credit.

rubricCriteria.title: Synchronization & Mutual Exclusion
rubricCriteria.description: Ensures mutual exclusion on the shared buffer using synchronized monitor or locks.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Correct intrinsic lock synchronization on all shared state accesses (1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Synchronizes put() but forgets to synchronize take(), or unsynchronized size checks (0.5 - 1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: No thread synchronization; race condition on queue access (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Spurious Wakeup Guard (while vs if)
rubricCriteria.description: Guards wait() inside a while loop rather than a single if check.
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Uses `if` instead of `while` before `wait()`, vulnerable to spurious wakeups (1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Busy waiting with while(true) instead of wait/notify (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Notification Strategy & Liveness
rubricCriteria.description: Proper wake-up signaling using notifyAll() to avoid thread starvation or deadlock.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Calls notifyAll() when an item is added or removed, preventing lost signals (1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Calls notify() instead of notifyAll(), risking signal loss in multi-producer multi-consumer setup (1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Omits notify/notifyAll completely, causing waiting threads to sleep permanently (0.0 marks).

penalties.title: Spurious Wakeup Bug (if instead of while)
penalties.description: Checked condition with 'if' before wait(); breaks concurrency invariants on spurious wakeup.

penalties.title: Potential Lost Wakeup / notify() instead of notifyAll()
penalties.description: Used notify() in multi-thread environment which can wake wrong waiter.

sections.name: Section A
sections.teachingNotes: Java Concurrency model, monitors, wait/notifyAll invariants.

studentScripts.evaluatorNotes: Textbook perfection: guarded while loops against spurious wakeups and notifyAll() to prevent deadlocks.
Deducted for using if() instead of while() before wait() and notify() instead of notifyAll().
studentScripts.feedbackNote: Always loop around wait() in Java concurrency because the thread might wake up when the buffer condition is not yet satisfied.

sections.name: Section B
sections.teachingNotes: Java Concurrency Utilities, Locks, Conditions, and Atomic variables.

studentScripts.evaluatorNotes: Modern ReentrantLock + Condition implementation as taught in Section B. Extremely high quality.
